subject: Product page risk flags, evidence binder, and field approval
messages:
From: MarketplacePM <pm@acme-retail.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-05T08:12:00-05:00
Subject: Listing evidence and potential compliance flags for Acme Retail listing

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for helping us get the Acme Retail listing live on AWS Marketplace. Before we finalize the product page copy we surfaced a couple of risk flags from our procurement and legal teams that we want to resolve quickly:

- Billing language: procurement flagged the current metering footnote for BYO-model SKUs as ambiguous — they need a clear on/on-call billing example.
- Hero claim: legal wants the evidence for the "3x inference cost reduction" claim. They asked for the benchmarking deck or a short summary of the test environment.
- PII/data flow: security wants confirmation that logs and KV cache are not exported to any third-party telemetry.

Can you share an evidence binder (PDF) and the preferred hero variants for the product page? Also, what's the fastest way to get the field team (sales) a short FAQ they can use during procurement calls?

Attachments: none on this message (we'll accept Drive links).

Appreciate the quick turn — Acme is targeting a launch announcement next week.

Best,
Asha Patel
Marketplace PM, Acme Retail

From: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
To: MarketplacePM <pm@acme-retail.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-05T10:00:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Listing evidence and potential compliance flags for Acme Retail listing

Hi Asha —

Thanks for the flags, helpful list. Quick plan and asks below so we can close these by EOD tomorrow:

1) Billing language: Kimberly, can you prepare a one-paragraph billing example that maps the SKU to expected monthly metering behavior + an explicit footnote we can paste into the product page? We'll also include the PrivateOffer/ReservedCapacity callout if Acme plans commitments.

2) Hero claim evidence: Sean, can you attach the benchmarking summary and a 1-slide PNG showing the test harness (model, sequence length, hardware) that legal can review? We can also include a short explanatory sentence for the hero to avoid overstating.

3) PII/data flow: I will draft a concise bullet list confirming telemetry practices and pointer to our security whitepaper. Asha, if procurement needs SOC2 artifacts or a control contact, share the specific request and we'll attach.

Deliverables we'll share in this thread: acme_evidence_binder_v2.pdf (binder w/benchmark summary + security callouts), listing_hero_variants.png (2 hero copy + 1 supporting line), billing_footnote_matrix.xlsx (billing examples and mapping).

Field FAQ: I'll put together a 1-pager (email) with two scripts: procurement script and security script — Kimberly, can you list the common procurement Qs you see?

If that sounds good, I'll publish the Drive folder link after Kimberly/Sean attach the files.

Thanks — moving fast on this so Acme can make their launch.

Regards,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Field Enablement, Redwood Inference

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: sean_gallagher@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-06T09:20:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Listing evidence and potential compliance flags for Acme Retail listing

Grace / team — attaching the artifacts we discussed. Summary below and quick notes for the product page: 

Attachments (attached to this email):
- acme_evidence_binder_v2.pdf (contains benchmark summary, test harness, methodology section, and note about repeatability)
- listing_hero_variants.png (two hero lines + short supporting subline)
- billing_footnote_matrix.xlsx (example scenarios mapped to SKU names and sample monthly charges)

Quick answers for procurement/security: 
- Billing: "Monthly charges are usage-based (tokens) for BYO models; Reserved Capacity and PrivateOffer options available for committed throughput. See billing_footnote_matrix.xlsx for scenario examples and a clear example line that reads: 'Example: With SKU-XL, ~1M tokens/month ≈ $X in usage charges (metering multiplier 1.0) — Reserved Capacity pricing available.'"

- Hero claim: The binder includes an A/B benchmark showing 2.9x token-per-second cost improvement on RTX A6000 with our KV caching + quantization path vs baseline open runtime. I recommend softening hero to: "Up to 3x lower inference cost in production workloads (benchmark varies by model and sequence length)". That keeps the claim supportable.

- PII/Data flow: Our security section confirms no customer KV cache or user prompt logs are exported to third parties. We log minimal operational metrics (latency, error rates) and have SOC2 artifacts available on request. Point-of-contact for audits: security_audit@redwood.com.

Field FAQ (draft bullets for outreach):
- "What evidence backs the cost claim?" -> short pointer to binder + 1-slide summary.
- "Will we need a PrivateOffer?" -> explain tradeoffs and when Reserved Capacity makes sense.
- "How do you handle logs?" -> short privacy statement + audit contact.

Grace — I can convert the FAQ into a one-page and add a script for SDRs. Let me know if you want this as a Google Doc link or a PDF.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Marketplace Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Acme Procurement <procurement@acme-retail.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: MarketplacePM <pm@acme-retail.com>
Date: 2026-12-07T14:03:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Listing evidence and potential compliance flags for Acme Retail listing

Hi Grace / Kimberly,

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the binder — we've started internal review. Two asks before we sign off for the listing page:

1) Can you include the one-line "softened" hero copy as the primary, and keep the detailed benchmark callout lower on the page? Procurement wants the headline conservative and the data accessible.

2) Can you provide a single-slide PDF that shows the exact test config (model name + GPU type + token length) with a one-sentence methodology note? Legal will want to attach that to the contract exhibit.

If you can drop the slide and the final hero text in the Drive link, we can route for final internal approval today.

Thanks — if it's easier, we can do a 20-minute sync this afternoon (1:30pm PT) — otherwise drop the files and we'll review.

Best,
Ravi Menon
Senior Manager, Procurement, Acme Retail
